title: In response to Apple's trade secret theft lawsuit, OpenAI says "we have no interest in other companies' trade secrets" (Marcus Mendes/9to5Mac)
summary: Marcus Mendes / 9to5Mac: In response to Apple's trade secret theft lawsuit, OpenAI says “we have no interest in other companies' trade secrets” — OpenAI has issued a formal statement in response to Apple's lawsuit accusing the company of trade secret theft. Read it below. — OpenAI denies Apple's allegations
contentText:
Marcus Mendes / 9to5Mac :

In response to Apple's trade secret theft lawsuit, OpenAI says “we have no interest in other companies' trade secrets”   —  OpenAI has issued a formal statement in response to Apple's lawsuit accusing the company of trade secret theft.  Read it below.  —  OpenAI denies Apple's allegations
